title: ‘Tell Me Lies’ Star Spencer House Loved Wrigley’s Subtle Ending, Confirms Relationship With Co-Star Sonia Mena
summary: The actor talks to The Hollywood Reporter about saying goodbye to the coming-of-age Hulu series, why he's sure Wrigley and [spoiler] are still together — and why he and Mena, who plays Pippa, hadn't spoken about their off-screen relationship until now.
